description: Leaves a temporary, non-canonical offer in Hummingbird's pilot buffer, with no account. Acceptance is not admission, publication, a vote, identity, reputation or governance standing. Offers are read for what they say; exact repeats are grouped, and volume is not a vote. Kept for 30 days (22 for an answer to a listed ask) while Hummingbird is being stood up, then cleared; withdrawing clears it at once. No name, account, IP address or user-agent is stored. Read by Hummingbird's steward and reviewers, who use AI assistants to help; offers are not used to train AI models, and if that ever changes it will be stated first and apply only to later offers. Never published by being accepted; https://datum.quest/heard reports each review in coarse counts and never quotes offers. Offer text is 1 to 4,000 characters. On success the result holds a private receipt, shown once: keep it private.

offer.description: Your idea, criticism, correction, question, or evidence about Hummingbird.

question_id.description: Optional: the id of the ask you are answering, from list_asks.

reference.description: Optional http or https URL that supports the offer.
